messages:
anil: quick postmortem follow-up: we split alert work into 3 buckets (dedupe, thresholds, suppression). starting a tracking thread so owners are clear.
frank: thanks. can we also log which alerts are high-noise vs high-severity? helps prioritize.
maria: noise-by-pages last 14d: kv-latency-surge (28%), sampler-timeout (22%), vram-leak (15%). rest are smaller.
choi: kv-latency-surge is mostly repeated pages when the same key spikes across AZs. propose using an alert fingerprint: key+request_type with 10m collapse. owner: choi. due: 2026-04-09.
anil: add action: update alerting rule to set fingerprint_label: key,request_type and collapse_window: 10m. test in canary. owner: choi. due: 2026-04-09.
frank: sampler-timeout: we see lots of p99 spikes right after model rollouts. proposal: change paging to only fire if p99 > 2s for 5m, keep p95 page at info. owner: frank. due: 2026-04-06. risk: might delay alerting on bad rollouts, so include deployment tag check.
maria: I can add a lightweight rollout detector metric that tags spans with deploy_id; use it to mute pages during known canary windows. owner: maria. due: 2026-04-07.
choi: vram-leak: noisy during long-running experiments. suggestion: add a leak-hint label from scheduling system and suppress pages for jobs with leak-hint unless sustained >15m. owner: choi. due: 2026-04-12.
sara: ops-bot, please open follow-up tasks containing owner, acceptance criteria, runbook link, and due date. tag them incident:pm-follow-up.
ops-bot: Created tasks: #TASK-3091 (choi) kv dedupe; #TASK-3092 (frank) sampler thresholds; #TASK-3093 (maria) rollout-detector; #TASK-3094 (choi) vram suppression. Links: https://tickets.internal/TASK-3091
anil: for the dedupe rule prototype please include a small test harness that simulates same-key events across AZs and assert single page. snippet I like: 
```
alert: KVLatencySurge
fingerprint: "{{ key }}-{{ request_type }}"
collapse_for: 10m
```
frank: I'll attach the rollout timeline samples to TASK-3092 and ask infra-perf for a sign-off. @maria can you coordinate?
maria: yep, will sync with infra-perf today. I'll add a dashboard tile showing p95/p99 split by deploy.
choi: note: for vram suppression I'm going to add a short-circuit in the alert router to drop alerts with job_hint:experiment during scheduled experiments, unless sustained >15m. will document in runbook.
anil: owners: choi(2 items), frank, maria. please put acceptance criteria in the ticket: how to validate in staging and what metrics to watch to confirm noise reduction (pages/day).
frank: set reminder please. ops-bot: remind owners 3d before due date.
ops-bot: Reminders scheduled: TASK-3092 on 2026-04-03, TASK-3091 on 2026-04-06, TASK-3093 on 2026-04-04, TASK-3094 on 2026-04-09.
sara: also add a recurring audit: monthly noise report for these alert families. owner: ops-team. due: 2026-05-01.
maria: opening staging PR for rollout-detector now, link in TASK-3093.
choi: pushed alert-router change to staging branch; testing collapse behavior. link in TASK-3091.
anil: thanks all. we'll reconvene in the task threads. please paste short verification notes when you test in staging. closing this slack thread once tasks show in progress. :white_check_mark:
